overview.description: The Principal Long Duration ETF (DWWN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in US Treasurys, including STRIPS, with long-term average duration. DWWN was launched on May 21, 2026 and is issued by Principal.
